items.title: Nitrite反序列化远程代码执行
items.title_zh: Nitrite反序列化远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 能写入存储值的攻击者构造恶意字节流，触发ObjectInputStream反序列化执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；禁止反序列化不可信数据并启用类型白名单
items.repro_note: 需可控写入Nitrite存储值，触发deserialize读取恶意字节
items.impact_scope: 内嵌Java数据库，影响集成该库的应用
items.description: This path deserializes stored values using NitriteDataType.deserialize(byte[]), which passes the raw bytes directly to java.io.ObjectInputStream.readObject() via a custom NitriteObjectInputStream subclass. That subclass overrides only readClassDescriptor() — solely to remap a handful of known legacy class names to their current equivalents — and implements no class allowlist, blocklist, or ObjectInputFilter (JEP 290).

items.title: AstroBlocks硬编码密钥会话伪造
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用发布包中公开的默认回退密钥伪造role=owner令牌，免认证接管CMS后台
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复时先更换回退密钥并轮换会话签名密钥
items.repro_note: 从公开包读取fallback密钥，按格式签名role=owner令牌访问后台
items.impact_scope: Astro站点CMS后台，中小站点常用
items.description: AstroBlocks is a block-first CMS for Astro projects. Prior to version 3.4.0, admin session tokens can be forged due to a hard-coded fallback JWT secret and a mismatched environment variable name. An attacker who knows the public fallback value (readable in the published package) can forge a valid session token with role: "owner" and obtain full administrative control of the CMS — creating/deleting content, users, media, redirects, and configuration. This issue has been patched in version 3.4.0.
